name: Lauterbrunnen valley of waterfalls
why: Along a flat green valley between 300 m cliffs, past the Staubbach falls and the glacier water roaring inside the mountain at Trümmelbach.
book: Free; Trümmelbach falls ticket (April to November). Bus back from Stechelberg.
dangers: Spray and wet rock at the falls.

points.name: Lauterbrunnen
points.note: The village under the Staubbach waterfall.

points.name: Trümmelbach Falls
points.note: Ten glacier waterfalls inside the mountain.

points.name: Stechelberg
points.note: The end of the valley road under the Mürren cliff.
